EO:13423 revokes the order as amended. The missing 42 USC 7545 biomass definition is affirmative incorporation evidence requiring the complete held statute before deciding residual scope.

research_rationale: PROVISIONAL producer decision, pending GitHub full corpus freeze. Unable to accept EO:13134 for review. Read complete original ORIGINAL:EO:13134, complete EO:13423 actor context, all own-term records and chain leads, original inventory and all conflicts/current-law leads; EO:13134 also includes complete EO:13225 context. EO:13423 §11(a) is a formal revocation effective 2007-01-24; no separate delayed date appears. The correct inventory preserves independent organizational, acquisition, reporting, training, definition, waiver, contractor and other commands rather than treating deadlines as ends. All current-law references must be resolved using held legal text: here the dossier expressly lacks those provision slices. Snippets cannot support a finding that incorporation is historical or extinguished. Conflict remains unresolved, so search_ids and conflict_resolutions stay empty and producer approval remains false. The advisory committee §§3–4 was formally revoked effective 2001-09-30 with prior termination acknowledged; other Council, departmental working-group, Coordination Office and definition provisions are separate. EO:13423 revokes the order as amended. The missing 42 USC 7545 biomass definition is affirmative incorporation evidence requiring the complete held statute before deciding residual scope.
unresolved_material_gaps: NO_ORDER_CITED_IN_CURRENT_LAW unresolved: need uniquely located complete attributed held legal text of USC 42 U.S.C. 7545 (with original-source hash, operative surrounding provision and cutoff currency); dossier supplies only lead/snippet and expressly records no legal-text evidence. Determine whether it incorporates a surviving independent command/definition, applies a historical reference, or is stale.

EO:13225 §3(a) expressly says the EO:13134 §§3–4 committee had already terminated and was superseded by the committee under §306 of the Biomass Research and Development Act of 2000, Title III P.L.106-224. Need held §306 and effective/transition provisions to establish first cessation of each committee/advisory-support command before the formal revocation effective 2001-09-30; the Act itself is not in this dossier.
